story.titleZh: 赛恩斯发布自制纪录片：回顾马德里主场特别一周
story.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车手卡洛斯·赛恩斯在个人YouTube频道更新自制系列《DONTBLINK》第七季第三集，以第一人称影像回顾马德里主场站前后一周的生活。
story.originalTitle: One very special week in Madrid 🇪🇸 I | DONTBLINK EP3 SEASON 7 by Carlos Sainz
story.summaryEn: Williams driver Carlos Sainz has released the third episode of Season 7 of his self-produced YouTube series DONTBLINK, using first-person footage to look back on his week around his home race in Madrid.
keyPointsZh: 本集内容紧贴上一站周末，属于车手自制的生活/赛周纪录片向内容。
keyPointsEn: The episode follows directly on from the previous race weekend and is self-produced documentary-style content covering the race week.
